summary: Master the art of upselling and cross selling with our expert-led training course. Increase your sales effectiveness and drive business growth now!
lede: Upselling and Cross-Selling Training teaches you to identify expansion opportunities, understand buying signals, and connect relevant offers to customer needs through structured discovery and consultative selling. You will build skills in value framing, upsell timing, cross-sell sequencing, objection handling, and follow-up while protecting customer trust. The course turns scattered selling habits into a repeatable approach using CRM records, opportunity notes, account planning, and offer-mapping templates. You will also explore conversion rate, average order value, customer lifetime value, renewal-linked expansion indicators, and action planning for live sales calls, QBRs, renewal conversations, and account reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for customer-facing professionals who influence revenue through account growth, renewal conversations, and solution positioning.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: basic sales or customer-facing experience, familiarity with CRM use, and working knowledge of product or service portfolios. You should be comfortable participating in role-play, reviewing customer scenarios, and using simple performance metrics such as conversion rate and average order value. No coding or programming is required. The advanced concepts in this course are taught at an operational level, with practical application in conversations, account planning, and revenue tracking.
